---
title: Tools
description: Let models call AL procedures through AIOS Tool Set.
---

Tools are AL procedures the model can invoke during generation. A **tool call** is a request from the model; a **tool result** is the text your procedure returns.

## Core objects

| Object | Role |
|---|---|
| `"AIOS Tool"` | One tool: name, description, JSON Schema input, and `Execute` |
| `"AIOS Tool Handler"` | Many tools in one codeunit: `GetDefinitions` + `Execute(Name, ...)` |
| `"AIOS Tool Set"` | Collection you pass into `GenerateText` |
| `"AIOS Tool Call"` | One model request: id, name, arguments |

Every tool exposes:

- **Name:** stable identifier sent to the provider (for example `echo`)
- **Description:** text that influences when the model selects the tool
- **Input schema:** JSON Schema for arguments, usually built with `"AIOS Schema"`
- **Execute:** runs the tool and writes `ResultText`; returns `true` on success and `false` on failure

## Multi-step generation

Pass a tool set into `GenerateText` with a step budget:

<include lang="al" meta='title="MultiStep.al"'>samples/tools/MultiStep.al</include>

The client:

1. Sends the prompt and tool definitions to the model.
2. Executes any tools requested by the model.
3. Sends the tool results back to the model.
4. Repeats until the model returns a final answer or `MaxSteps` is reached.

`MaxSteps` values below 1 are treated as 1. Each generation step counts once toward the limit. `GenerateText(Model, Request, ToolSet)` without `MaxSteps` allows 5 steps.

### Outcomes

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| Model returns text (no tool calls) | Success; `Output()` is the final answer |
| Model requests a registered tool | Tool runs and the loop continues |
| Model requests an unknown tool name | Generation fails with an invalid-request error |
| Tool `Execute` returns `false` | The tool result is sent back to the model and the loop continues |
| Last step still has tool calls | The result reports `HasToolCalls()` and `StoppedAtStepLimit()` as `true` |

Structured output and RecRef binding run on the final non-tool-call step only.


### A run, end to end

With the `echo` tool registered and a prompt of `Echo the word ping`, the loop takes two model calls. The model asks for the tool, the client runs it and sends the result back, and the second response is the final answer:

| Step | Model returns | Client does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | tool call `echo` with `{"message":"ping"}` | Runs `Execute`, appends `ping` as the tool result |
| 2 | `The echo tool returned: ping` | Stops, because there are no tool calls left |

The result reflects the whole run, not just the last call:

| Accessor | Value |
|---|---|
| `Result.Output()` | `The echo tool returned: ping` |
| `Result.GetStepCount()` | `2` |
| `Result.HasToolCalls()` | `false` |
| `Result.StoppedAtStepLimit()` | `false` |

Had `MaxSteps` been `1`, the loop would stop after step 1 and the result would indicate that more steps were needed. Values below `1` are treated as `1`.

## Choose a registration pattern

| Pattern | API | Fit |
|---|---|---|
| Interface tool | `ToolSet.Add(Tool)` | Reusable single-tool codeunits |
| Handler pack | `ToolSet.Use(Handler)` | Several tools behind one object ID |
| Named + event | `ToolSet.Add(Name, Description, Schema)` | Definitions at the call site; execute via `OnBeforeExecuteTool` |
| Definition object | `ToolSet.Add(ToolDefinition(...))` | Same as named Add, from a JSON definition |

You can combine interface tools and named tools on the same `"AIOS Tool Set"`. Execution order for a name is: interface tool, then handler (if set), then `OnBeforeExecuteTool`.

## Handler packs

Implement `"AIOS Tool Handler"` when several tools should share one object ID.

`GetDefinitions` returns a JSON array of `{ name, description, parameters }` objects. Build each entry with `ToolSet.ToolDefinition(...)`.

`ToolSet.Use(Handler)`:

1. Stores the handler for execution
2. Registers every definition from `GetDefinitions()`

<include lang="al" meta='title="MyAppTools.al"'>samples/tools/MyAppTools.al</include>

<include lang="al" meta='title="UseHandler.al"'>samples/tools/UseHandler.al</include>

## Named tools and OnBeforeExecuteTool

Register a definition on the tool set and handle execution in an `OnBeforeExecuteTool` subscriber on `"AIOS Tool Set"`. Set `Handled := true` after matching the name.

<include lang="al" meta='title="AddNamed.al"'>samples/tools/AddNamed.al</include>

Equivalent registration from a definition object:

<include lang="al" meta='title="AddDefinition.al"'>samples/tools/AddDefinition.al</include>

Subscriber shape:

<include lang="al" meta='title="OnBeforeExecuteTool.al"'>samples/tools/OnBeforeExecuteTool.al</include>

Set `Handled := true` after handling the name and set `Succeeded` to the tool outcome.

## Manual step control

Use `GenerateText(Model, Request)` when you want one model call per invocation. Attach tools with `Request.SetTools(ToolSet)`, then continue the conversation yourself.

<include lang="al" meta='title="ManualContinue.al"'>samples/tools/ManualContinue.al</include>

| Helper | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Request.SetTools(ToolSet)` | Publishes tool definitions on the request |
| `Request.EnsureMessagesFromPrompt()` | Builds the message list from system + prompt when empty |
| `Request.AppendAssistantToolCalls(...)` | Adds the assistant turn that requested tools |
| `ToolSet.Execute(Name, Arguments, ResultText)` | Runs one tool by name |
| `Request.AppendToolResult(Id, Name, Content)` | Adds the tool result message correlated by call id |

## Inspect the run

| Accessor | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Result.Output()` | Final text, or validated JSON when structured output applies |
| `Result.HasToolCalls()` | Last model response still contains tool calls |
| `Result.GetToolCalls()` | List of `"AIOS Tool Call"` from that response |
| `Result.StoppedAtStepLimit()` | Loop ended because `MaxSteps` was reached before a final answer |
| `Result.GetStepCount()` | Number of generation steps |
| `Result.GetTotalInputTokens()` / `GetTotalOutputTokens()` | Aggregated usage across steps |

## Tool Set reference

{/* api-owner: "AIOS Tool Set" */}

| Procedure | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `Add(Tool)` | Registers an `"AIOS Tool"`; duplicate names error |
| `Use(Handler)` | Sets the handler and registers all `GetDefinitions()` entries |
| `Add(Name, Description, Parameters)` | Registers a named tool for handler or `OnBeforeExecuteTool` |
| `Add(Definition)` | Registers from `{ name, description, parameters }` |
| `ToolDefinition(Name, Description, Parameters)` | Builds one definition object |
| `Register(Name, Description, Parameters)` | Same registration as named `Add` |
| `SetHandler(Handler)` | Sets the executor for named tools |
| `Execute(Name, Arguments, ResultText)` | Runs the tool and returns whether it succeeded |
| `GetDefinitions()` | Combined definitions for interface + named tools |
| `Count()` / `HasTool(Name)` | Inspection helpers |
